Kind of curious what this would look like for other characters so I thought I'd post it here for others to maybe do too? Basically here's a stream of consciousness style journal entry from Leaf. Unfiltered Leaf is pretty fun to write 😂

*While Leaf usually puts a lot of effort into her handwriting, the penmanship here is much more informal, switching haphazardly between Common and Goblin.*

|| Had a really bad dream last night. I'm used to nightmares but this was really spooky. Haven't really felt good all day, but I guess it'll pass. Things pass. Things change. A lot has changed. I have a house now. Never thought I'd have one of those. Granted, it's a tree so not a normal house but what about me would ever be normal. What even is normal? Apparently not me because people keep saying I'm "special". What's special about me? I don't think they mean special like goblin, no one's ever said anything like that at least. "you're different for a goblin". Yuck. Other goblins can be like me, I just don't know any. Maybe there's some here? No, I think they mean the way I act? But I still don't get it. I just want to help people. What's special about that? Isn't that what other people want too? Who doesn't want to help people? I guess maybe Solomon. I don't know what his deal is. Keeps running around causing trouble for 500 years. If I had 500 years to live I don't think I'd spend it like that. Is that what makes me special? I dont want to hurt people? Ugh Zone of Truth and Command. Never again. Made me feel icky. I hope Amara isn't mad about that. Or Ophelia. We haven't talked much. So many people to talk to. Never had this many things to do in a day. All I did was build a treehouse today. Again, more tree than house. Just the way it should be. Maybe that's special? I wonder if Mello thinks the same thing? People probably call her special all the time. I know I do. ||
